name: zfmv_playback_set_dest_rect
description: zFMV_Playback::SetDestRect copies the caller rectangle to destinationRect, sets the MCI destination put flag, and returns the updated flag word.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x462540 is a thiscall leaf that copies rect->left/top/right/bottom into self->destinationRect at offsets 0x1c, 0x20, 0x24, and 0x28.
It ORs self->mciPutFlags at offset 0x00 with 0x40000, stores the updated value back to self->mciPutFlags, returns that value in eax, and cleans up the single rect argument.
known_limits: Tier S current: zfmv_playback_methods VC5SP3 compare passes for 0x462540 with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 0 relocation-masked bytes and 5 trimmed VC NOP bytes.
